seo.title: Best Libraries for Astro in 2026
seo.description: Essential Astro libraries for content sites, integrations, SEO, UI components, and deployment. Curated from real Astro projects.

introduction: Astro clicked for me the moment I realized content sites don't need a JavaScript framework fighting the browser. I've rebuilt two production sites with Astro and the performance improvements were dramatic. These libraries represent what the Astro ecosystem does best — fast content delivery with islands of interactivity where you actually need them.

categories.name: Official Integrations
categories.description: First-party Astro integrations maintained by the core team for common frameworks, renderers, and adapters.

items.name: @astrojs/react
items.description: Adds React component support to Astro via islands architecture. Bring your existing React components and they only hydrate on the client when specified. The migration path from Next.js starts here.
items.highlight: Use React components as interactive islands in Astro

items.name: @astrojs/svelte
items.description: Svelte integration for Astro. Svelte's compile-time approach pairs beautifully with Astro's zero-JS-by-default philosophy. The smallest client-side footprint of any framework integration.

items.name: @astrojs/tailwind
items.description: Official Tailwind CSS integration with automatic configuration. Just install and start using utility classes. Handles the PostCSS setup, content paths, and base styles automatically.

items.name: @astrojs/mdx
items.description: MDX support for Astro — write Markdown with embedded components. Perfect for documentation sites and blogs where you need interactive elements inside content pages.
items.highlight: Embed interactive components inside Markdown content

items.name: @astrojs/sitemap
items.description: Automatically generates a sitemap.xml from your Astro routes at build time. Configure once and every page gets indexed. Essential for SEO and takes two lines to set up.

items.name: @astrojs/vercel
items.description: Deploy Astro to Vercel with SSR, edge functions, and image optimization. The adapter handles all the Vercel-specific configuration. One of the smoothest deployment experiences for Astro.

categories.name: Content & CMS
categories.description: Libraries and integrations for managing content in Astro sites — from local Markdown to headless CMS platforms.

items.name: Astro Content Collections
items.description: Astro's built-in system for organizing, validating, and querying local content with Zod schemas. Type-safe frontmatter, automatic slugs, and collection references. No external dependency needed.
items.highlight: Type-safe content with Zod validation — built into Astro

items.name: Starlight
items.description: Astro's official documentation theme. Full-featured docs site in minutes — search, i18n, sidebar navigation, and versioning. Used by the Astro docs themselves. Customizable but opinionated about structure.
items.highlight: Production-ready documentation site in under 5 minutes

items.name: Keystatic
items.description: A file-based CMS that gives non-developers a visual editor for Astro content collections. Content stays in your repo as Markdown/JSON. No database, no external service, just better editing.
items.highlight: Visual CMS that writes to your git repo — no database needed

items.name: Sanity + Astro
items.description: Sanity's real-time headless CMS with an official Astro integration. GROQ queries in your Astro pages, live previews, and visual editing. The best option for content-heavy sites with editorial teams.

items.name: Tina CMS
items.description: Git-backed CMS with visual inline editing for Astro sites. Editors modify content directly on the rendered page. The editing experience is great, though setup is more involved than Keystatic.

items.name: Storyblok Astro
items.description: Storyblok's visual editor works well with Astro's component model. Drag-and-drop page building with live preview. The best CMS for marketing teams who need layout control without developer involvement.
items.highlight: Drag-and-drop page building with live preview

categories.name: SEO & Performance
categories.description: Libraries for optimizing Astro sites for search engines, performance, and web standards.

items.name: astro-seo
items.description: A component that generates all the meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter cards, and JSON-LD structured data you need. Pass props, get SEO. Saves writing the same head tags across every page.
items.highlight: All your SEO meta tags from a single component

items.name: @astrojs/image / astro:assets
items.description: Astro's built-in image optimization automatically resizes, converts to modern formats, and lazy loads images. No external service needed — images are optimized at build time.
items.highlight: Build-time image optimization with zero configuration

items.name: Partytown
items.description: Offloads third-party scripts to a web worker so they don't block the main thread. Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, and other tracking scripts run without affecting Core Web Vitals.
items.highlight: Move analytics scripts off the main thread

items.name: astro-compress
items.description: Compresses HTML, CSS, JS, images, and SVGs in your Astro build output. A post-build optimization step that squeezes extra bytes out of every asset. Simple to add, measurable improvements.

items.name: Pagefind
items.description: A static search library that indexes your Astro site at build time. Full-text search with no server, no API, and a tiny (< 100KB) client bundle. The best search solution for static Astro sites.
items.highlight: Full-text search with no server — 100% static

categories.name: UI & Styling
categories.description: Component libraries, styling tools, and UI utilities for building beautiful Astro sites.

items.name: Astro Icon
items.description: An icon component that supports Iconify's 100k+ icons and local SVGs. Icons are inlined as SVGs — no external requests, no JavaScript, just clean markup. The way icons should work.
items.highlight: 100k+ icons inlined as SVGs with zero JavaScript

items.name: Tailwind CSS
items.description: The natural styling choice for Astro projects. Utility classes work perfectly with Astro's component model and the build-time processing means zero runtime CSS overhead.

items.name: UnoCSS
items.description: An atomic CSS engine that's faster than Tailwind with a smaller output. Compatible with Tailwind's utility classes but also supports Windi CSS and custom rulesets. Great for performance-obsessed Astro sites.
items.highlight: Faster and smaller than Tailwind with compatible syntax

items.name: Fontsource
items.description: Self-host open-source fonts as npm packages. No Google Fonts request, no FOUT, just import and use. Works perfectly with Astro's build pipeline and eliminates external font loading latency.

items.name: astro-embed
items.description: Embed YouTube, Vimeo, and Twitter content without their heavy JavaScript embeds. Renders a static preview that loads the full embed on interaction. Massive performance win for content sites.
items.highlight: Lightweight embeds that load heavy scripts only on interaction

items.name: Astro Themes
items.description: A curated directory of free and premium Astro themes. Good starting points for blogs, portfolios, documentation, and landing pages. Quality varies, but the top-rated ones are well-maintained.

categories.name: Deployment Adapters
categories.description: Adapters that deploy Astro to various hosting platforms with SSR, edge rendering, or static hosting.

items.name: @astrojs/node
items.description: Run Astro with SSR on any Node.js server. The most flexible adapter — deploy to any VPS, Docker container, or Node hosting platform. Full control but you manage the server yourself.

items.name: @astrojs/cloudflare
items.description: Deploy Astro to Cloudflare Pages with edge SSR. Cloudflare's global network means sub-50ms responses worldwide. The adapter handles Workers-specific APIs and bindings automatically.
items.highlight: Edge SSR on Cloudflare's global network

items.name: @astrojs/netlify
items.description: Netlify adapter with support for edge functions, on-demand rendering, and image CDN. One-click deploys from git with automatic preview deployments for pull requests.

items.name: Coolify
items.description: Self-host Astro on your own servers with Coolify's PaaS interface. Supports both static and SSR Astro deployments via Docker. No per-request pricing and full infrastructure control.

items.name: Deno Deploy
items.description: Deploy Astro to Deno's edge network with the Deno adapter. Zero cold starts, global distribution, and generous free tier. A compelling option if you're exploring beyond Node.js hosting.

items.name: GitHub Pages
items.description: Deploy static Astro sites for free on GitHub Pages. Use the official GitHub Actions workflow for automatic builds on push. Perfect for personal sites, docs, and open-source project pages.
items.highlight: Free static hosting with automatic GitHub Actions deployment
